description: Department of Veterans Affairs intends to issue a sole source delivery award to Olympus America, Inc. for an Olympus brand Bronchoscope. This award will be a delivery order against the Olympus America, Inc. contract on the GSA/FSS Multiple Award Schedule. The NAICS code is 334510, the size standard is 1250 employees and the PSC is 6515. This sole source GSA/FSS delivery order falls under authorities implemented by FAR 8.405-6. See attached Intent to Sole Source Description for details. All responses must have the VA Identifier 36C26326Q0441 in the subject line of the email. All responses must be received no later than: 04:30pm Central Time, Wednesday March 18, 2026. All responses must be submitted to this email address: Joseph.Bennett@va.gov
